faq.q: What kinds of moves do you handle?
faq.a: We handle local residential moves, Texas intrastate moves, office and commercial relocations, packing, short-term storage and specialty items including pianos and antiques.
Yes. We handle the whole job—packing, protecting furniture and floors, loading, transport, unloading and placing everything in the right rooms. You can also choose just the parts you need.

faq.q: Can you handle a difficult move?
faq.a: Yes—hard moves are where an experienced crew shows. Third-floor walk-ups, narrow bungalow doors, small elevators, pianos and long Hill Country driveways are all part of the job. Tell us about the access at both ends and we plan the crew and equipment around it.
Yes. Advantage Moving is licensed and insured. Our Texas Department of Motor Vehicles number is 000572890B.
We consider the size of your move, access at both locations, travel distance, crew needs and optional services. Call or send your details for a personalized estimate.

faq.q: How far do you travel for local moves?
faq.a: We serve Austin and every town south along I-35, including Buda and Kyle, plus communities within about 30 miles of our Buda office. For longer distances we handle moves anywhere within Texas.
Yes. We serve Greater Austin and Central Texas, and we move customers anywhere within the state of Texas.
Yes. Our crews arrive with moving essentials and can help with packing, shrink-wrapping and protecting floors, walls and delicate belongings.
